newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gives military formal advisory role.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gives military formal advisory role.

text.p: Pakistani President Farooq Leghari issued a decree on Monday giving the heads of the armed forces a formal advisory role in government affairs.

The cabinet of caretaker Prime Minister Meraj Khalid met on Monday and unanimously approved the presidential order to form a Council for Defence and National Security, a government minister told reporters.

The council will comprise the president, the prime minister and ministers for defence, foreign, interior and finance, chairman of Joint Chiefs of Staff Committee, and chiefs of the army, navy and air force, the order said.

The subjects on which the council can advise include "determination of national strategy and fixation of priorities in terms of overall national security", formation of a defence policy and coordinating it with external and domestic policies.

It can also be asked to advise the government on "definition of the task of the armed forces...in accordance with the national strategy", economic and financial policies affecting defence and national security, and recommend on internal security and proclamation of emergency.
